title: Open Project
subtitle: Open or clone the selected project in the default app.

title: Open Folder in Finder
subtitle: Reveal the selected local project folder in Finder.

title: Project Actions
subtitle: Open the selected project's repository and plugin actions.

title: Open New Session
subtitle: Start a fresh session for the selected project.

title: Open in Terminal
subtitle: Open the selected project in the default terminal app.

title: Open in IDE
subtitle: Open the selected project in the default IDE or code editor.

title: Open in AI Client
subtitle: Open the selected project in the default AI client.

title: Open in Documents
subtitle: Open the selected project in the default documents app.

title: Open in Git Diff
subtitle: Open the selected project in the default Git diff viewer.

title: Copy Repository URL
subtitle: Copy the selected project's repository URL to the clipboard.

title: Copy Open In Deeplink
subtitle: Copy the selected Open In target's deeplink for the project.

title: Open Repository in Browser
subtitle: Open the selected project's repository URL in the browser.

title: Sync Remote
subtitle: Fast-forward the current branch from its Git remote.

title: Reload Projects
subtitle: Refresh project metadata and reload the visible results.

title: Add New Project
subtitle: Add a repository to the project source.

title: Edit Repository
subtitle: Edit the selected repository's saved import entry.

title: Project Row Settings
subtitle: Change per-repository or subpath project settings.

title: Add Subpath
subtitle: Add a first-level folder as a searchable project result.

title: Delete Project
subtitle: Remove the selected repository from the project source.

title: Add or Change Project Icon
subtitle: Save or replace the selected project's custom icon.

title: Exclude Project from Results
subtitle: Hide the selected local project from the results list.

title: Project Settings
subtitle: Open command-level project preferences.

title: Toggle Favorite
subtitle: Add or remove the selected row from favorites.

title: Move to Bottom
subtitle: Move a non-favorite row below recent selections.
